items.title: Charles L. Dufour Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: the jazz musicologists like Sue and Edmond Souchon and Myra Menville and Goop Kennedy knows quite a bit about it.

ctx.x: the party generally tended to have jazz bands, a ragtime

ball. Well, I had the ragtime band, yeah. What about when you were in college? What kind of band was that? Well, like I say, I wasn't a great party hound, so I'm not in a position to give you any expert information. But when they had the dance houses, they'd hire a band. They would play the popular music of the day, and the popular music of the day. Well, back in the days of Charleston, they played a piece called Charlton Ta-da, I don't know if anything goes. And the Black Bottom and all those kind of things.…
